header.subtitle: Check your camera and microphone, clean up air-conditioner noise, record a practice run and get feedback. All video and audio stays on your machine.

checker.vuHint: Goal: while speaking, keep the level in the green zone (−12 to −6 dBFS). Amber = a bit low; red = clipping (lower the gain).
checker.micTestDone: Done — play it below. Repeat with another source to compare.
checker.micTestHint: Recorded from the selected source. Pick Speak Clean Mic to hear it filtered, or the physical mic to hear the original and compare.
checker.noiseHint: Once enabled, Chrome, Zoom and Meet can pick “Speak Clean Mic” and receive audio without the air-conditioner hum.
checker.filterNotYet: (The source hasn't appeared yet; wait a second.)
checker.vcamHint: While on, pick “Speak Cam” as your webcam in Zoom, Meet or OBS. Video stays on your machine — only Speak Cam receives the retouched image. Requires camera/install.sh (v4l2loopback).
checker.vcamUnavailable: Not available. Run: sudo bash camera/install.sh (installs v4l2loopback).

record.previewPausedHint: The live preview appears here while you record.
record.saved: Saved: {{path}} — analyze it in the Feedback tab.
record.recordHint: Each recording is saved in the chosen project's folder with the date and time. Use the Speak Clean Mic microphone (if you enabled the filter) to record without noise. When you stop, go to the Feedback tab to analyze.

feedback.noFeedbackConfigured: No Claude feedback (configure the provider in .env: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or Vertex).
feedback.feedbackOmitted: Local metrics only — Claude feedback skipped: {{err}}
feedback.cost: Tokens: {{input}} input + {{output}} output = {{total}}. Cost: {{cost}}. Model: {{model}}. (Transcription and metrics: local, $0.)
feedback.noSavedMetrics: This session has no saved metrics.

nonverbal.disclaimer: Local proxy: "eye contact" = head orientation toward the camera; "expression" = observable facial movement, not emotion; "posture" is a heuristic.

delete.videoConfirm: Delete the recording "{{name}}"? It will be removed from disk along with its history. This cannot be undone.
delete.projectConfirm: Delete the project "{{slug}}"? Its folder must be empty (delete the recordings first).
